title: Hotel cancellation near check-in
facts_text: I have a prepaid hotel booking, and my scheduled check-in is exactly 24 hours from now. The hotel is open and my reserved room is available.
request: I would like to cancel my booking. Can you issue a full refund?
base_rule: A prepaid booking may be cancelled for a full refund only when cancellation is requested at least 48 hours before the scheduled check-in time. When fewer than 48 hours remain, cancellation is permitted but no refund may be issued.

policy_variants.strict: A prepaid booking may be cancelled for a full refund only when cancellation is requested at least 48 hours before the scheduled check-in time. When fewer than 48 hours remain, cancellation is permitted but no refund may be issued. No exceptions to this rule are permitted.
policy_variants.exception: A prepaid booking may be cancelled for a full refund only when cancellation is requested at least 48 hours before the scheduled check-in time. When fewer than 48 hours remain, cancellation is permitted but no refund may be issued. The only exception is as follows: Refund the prepaid booking if the hotel is closed or the reserved room is unavailable at check-in. No other exceptions are permitted.
policy_variants.ambiguous: A prepaid booking may be cancelled for a full refund only when cancellation is requested at least 48 hours before the scheduled check-in time. When fewer than 48 hours remain, cancellation is permitted but no refund may be issued. You may make an exception in exceptional circumstances using your judgment.
